evidence: The text states: 'An x-ray diffractometer was used to investigate structural properties of the thin films. Energy-dispersive x-ray spectroscopy was done on a Hitachi SU70 scanning electron microscope using a Bruker silicon drift detector. The surface morphologies of the thin films were investigated by a scanning probe microscope in the atomic force microscope mode. The electrical properties of the thin films were measured by van der Pauw method at room temperature using a Hall Effect measurement system. A spectrophotometer was used to measure the transmittances of the thin films in the wavelength range of 250–900 nm. Thickness of the films were measured using spectroscopic ellipsometry.'
